builds.name: Judgment three-second spin ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Judgment three-second spin within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Judgment three-second spin within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: E5 strike is16+0.52AD; nearest target takes25% extra; six hits shred25% armor. Source crit modifier is1+0.3*(critDamage-1), not ordinary attack multiplier. IE supplies75AD,25% crit and30% crit damage. Collector/Essence Reaver/Lord Dominik reach100% item crit with IE. Bloodthirster adds80AD; Hubris has exactly10 credited kills. Lord Dominik sole armor-penetration family; verify its bonus-health amplifier. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. Nearest victim remains for3s; record actual strikes/crit. Hubris exactly10 credited kills, buff active90s; unbounded kills/time have no finite global maximum.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Judgment three-second spin tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Source NumberOfStrikes7 does not prove runtime AS-scaled count; later shred not retroactive. Raw statFormula=2/Stat identifiers remain source evidence until runtime mapping confirmed; no unspecified stats/stacks granted.
tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
